wLine.derivation: First candidate Dehydroacetic Acid@19 (class b): (i) holds, (ii) fails on PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide@22. Next candidate Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone@25 (class a, closed allergen list): (i) Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate@2 before it; (ii) between 25 and the cap 31 only Benzoic Acid, Lactic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Disodium EDTA, Phenoxyethanol -> plausible. No alphabetical run of >=7 entries.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate@2 with the prominent amphoteric co-surfactant Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3 directly behind it. Counter-signal recorded: two further mild anionics (Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate@4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate@5) and the foam-boosting PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide@22; with the betaine in second place they do not realistically move the convention value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high: C2 is met with prominent elements - silicone Amodimethicone/Morpholinomethyl Silsesquioxane Copolymer@16 (and prominent payload lipids Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil@7, Sunflower Seed Oil@9), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@13, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate@11, humectants Glycerin@6 and Sodium PCA@14. A rich architecture (W-RICH, E3 reading) also holds: prominent payload lipids converge with silicone and cationic deposition (plus cationic conditioners @15, @21 and proteins @8, @12). Counter-signal: the silicone copolymer sits after Sodium PCA, so it may be a low-dose route; with oils, guar and two quats also present this does not plausibly move the value.

weightPotential.rationale: high: W-RICH with limited reset - material payload lipids Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil@7 and Sunflower Seed Oil@9 (before the W-line Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone@25) converge with persistent amino-silicone (@16) and cationic deposition (Guar@13, quats @15, @21) in a mild C6 chassis (resetCapacity weak); the convergence route also holds (payload_lipid + silicone + cationic_polymer + cationic_conditioner + protein_film). Confidence moderate, neighbor moderate: liquid oils and a single guar at mid-list leave realistic room for a bounded result.
weightPotential.counterevidence: The lipids are liquid oils (less persistent than butters/waxes); each cationic route is listed once and after Glycerin; the silicone is an amino-silicone copolymer after Sodium PCA (likely low dose).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Five deposition families converge, the lipid leg is material under W-LINE, and the isethionate/betaine/sulfosuccinate chassis offers only weak reset, so the high anchor rich route (W-RICH + limited reset) is met.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need either an effective reset that offsets the deposition or evidence that the converging systems are light; the chassis is mild (C6 low) and five families converge, so moderate would understate the residue risk (P0).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Actual oil and silicone levels are unknown; liquid oils at positions 7/9 could be small additions.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): not_targeted, because SC1 positioning (an E2 sensitive/dry claim unit graded moderate/high) cannot be seen in the blind pass. Formula half (CSA) recorded for reconciliation: CSA would pass through the humectant/refatting list (Glycerin@6, Argan Oil@7, Sunflower Seed Oil@9, Sodium PCA@14 all prominent), but no E4 comfort route (Panthenol, Allantoin, Bisabolol, ...) is present, so an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail while an S-DRY gate could pass. Counter-signals: declared Parfum@31 with Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone@25; no cooling agent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: the complete INCI contains none of Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole, Selenium Sulfide or Selenium Disulfide (Section 11 table). Formula complete per packet (ID-1).
